newsitem.title: RWANDA: U.N. staff involved in shooting in Rwanda-official.
newsitem.headline: U.N. staff involved in shooting in Rwanda-official.

text.p: United Nations human rights staff were involved in a shooting incident in southwestern Rwanda on Tuesday and a U.N. translator was wounded, a U.N. official said.
First reports indicated that there might have been deaths, a senior diplomat said.
"There has been an incident in Karengera southeast of Cyangugu," said U.N. human rights spokeswoman Marie Vander Elst.

"Our translator has been shot and wounded and we lost communication with two expatriate staff, one of whom is British. The Rwandan army is escorting our vehicles to the site as we speak but we cannot confirm whether our staff are alive or dead."

"We have received reports of the incident," a senior Western diplomat told Reuters in the capital Kigali, "and we have had reports that there have been killings. We cannot confirm this but these are the reports we have had."
